description: The feature image selected for 'DFW Is Now the AI Talent Market' (a post specifically about the Dallas-Fort Worth metro) was a generic city skyline photo, not a DFW skyline. The Unsplash search did not verify that the image actually depicted DFW.
correction: When a post is geographically specific, the image search query must be specific enough to confirm the location matches. A city skyline is not a DFW skyline — the search query and image selection must include the location name and the result should be visually verifiable.
systemic_fix: Update step-01-discover.md image sourcing guidance: when the post title or hook names a specific city/region, the Unsplash search query must include that city name, and the alt-text/caption of the returned photo must be inspected to confirm geographic match before accepting. Add to Gate 2 assertions: geographic specificity check when post is location-named.
